findings.summary: First execution of evidence-safe Actions pruning succeeded: deleted=102 kept=54 failed=0 protected_ids=228. Protection layers worked as designed for claim-bearing history: every run id embedded in cycle/* branch names and every id reachable from accepted lab/* heads' state/docs/results/reports was protected; all 102 deletions came from unprotected supervisor/watchdog/council orchestration workflows.

PROVENANCE INCIDENT: this run permanently deleted the raw Actions logs of 102 runs (window 2026-08-24T23:32:44Z..2026-08-25T17:42:27Z). The deletion manifest survives ONLY in this run's log. Distillation completed: 102 tombstones written under evidence/run-memory/deleted/, aggregated in DELETED_RUNS_RECOVERY.json. Loss assessment: 98 NONE_MATERIAL, 4 UNKNOWN (four of five deleted SPIDER Critical CTO Council runs left no run-id-attributable durable artifact), 0 MATERIAL_RISK.

Git recovery found that deleted CTO Council run 32876814203 had durably persisted its full output as commit 6b1f030 on origin/lab/cto ('CTO critical review 32876814203'): docs/CTO_LEDGER.md with entries CTO-1..CTO-4, five docs/CTO_TO_*.md lane advisories, state/cto_direction.json (council_pass=CTO-4, top bottleneck ONE-SHOT-DECODE-DEBT). Its loss is therefore NONE_MATERIAL despite log deletion. Commit durability is Git-verified during distillation; the advisory CONTENT remains unaudited CTO synthesis, not scientific evidence.

Four deleted Critical CTO Council runs (32864023130, 32864726559, 32875585131, 32879434960) have NO attributable durable artifact in any fetched ref. Cumulative ledger coverage is plausible (same-day passes, later supersede earlier) but unverifiable per-run post-deletion. Additionally cto_direction.json references pre-CTO-4 pass sha origin/lab/cto@4b77e70 which was not fetchable at recovery time.

Guard-version gap: the script version that executed (3e5ea6d) pruned completed orchestration runs immediately with no distillation requirement. Maintainers subsequently hardened it (1afb229 'require durable run distillation before pruning'; a09d036 'restore durable-reference protection before pruning'), implicitly confirming v1 guards were insufficient. Any future hygiene run must use the hardened version AND only prune runs already distilled into run-memory.

Run cost: ~59s wall clock total; ~43s for 102 sequential gh api DELETE calls (~0.42s/delete); checkout fetch-depth=0 of a many-branch repo. Orchestration-noise volume is the dominant Actions cost driver: 102 supervisor/watchdog runs were created in ~18.2h (~5.6 runs/h), vs 54 kept runs. Ox Watchdog alone contributed 39 of 102 deletions.

Research/infra opportunities surfaced by the incident: (1) make every council/supervisor workflow persist a run-id-attributed receipt commit BEFORE it can be pruned (structural recoverability instead of after-the-fact Git archaeology); (2) extend evidence/run-memory so future hygiene passes prune only runs marked distillation_complete+safe_to_prune=true; (3) reconsider watchdog/supervisor cadence (~5.6 runs/h of pure orchestration).

failure_signatures: None observed in this run (failed=0; no '::warning::Could not delete run' emitted). For future runs, the failure signature to watch is '::warning::Could not delete run <id>' indicating an API delete rejection.
research_opportunities: Structural provenance: require all autonomous orchestration workflows (cto-council, *-supervisor, watchdogs) to emit a durable receipt (commit or evidence/run-memory entry) containing their run id before completion, making post-hoc recovery unnecessary.

Distillation-gated retention policy: hygiene should consume evidence/run-memory safe_to_prune flags rather than heuristic recency only (KEEP_LATEST_PER_WORKFLOW=3 currently keeps raw logs of un-distilled runs only by count, not by evidential value).
already_captured_elsewhere: Deleted-run inventory and loss assessment: evidence/run-memory/DELETED_RUNS_RECOVERY.json + evidence/run-memory/deleted/*.json (authoritative for the deletion incident)
CTO-4 council substance: origin/lab/cto@6b1f030 docs/CTO_LEDGER.md, state/cto_direction.json (pre-existing durable memory, linked not reinterpreted)
pruning_rationale: NOT safe to prune: this run's log is the SOLE surviving authoritative manifest of exactly which 102 raw Action logs were deleted (id|workflow|timestamp|path lines). Deleting it would destroy the only independent record backing the tombstones and DELETED_RUNS_RECOVERY.json. It also carries the exact script version that executed, needed to audit the guard-version gap. Conservative rule applied per EVIDENCE_CURATOR.md.
